description: The right-hand plot in Figure 1 compares the training loss of the vanilla Transformer (purple line with square markers) and the proposed SepLLM (red line with circle markers) as a function of training time in seconds. The x-axis, labeled “Training Time (s)”, spans from 0 to 250,000 seconds with major tick marks at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss”, ranges from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at 0.05 intervals. Both models start at approximately the same loss value near 2.75 at time zero. As training progresses, both lines trend downward, indicating decreasing loss. The red SepLLM line consistently remains below the purple vanilla line, indicating lower loss at all measured time points. At approximately 200,000 seconds, a green dashed horizontal line marks a reference loss level, and a green box highlights the region where SepLLM reaches this loss level at around 160,000 seconds, while vanilla reaches it later, near 200,000 seconds. A label “1.26×” in the green box indicates that SepLLM achieves the same loss 1.26 times faster than the vanilla Transformer. The plot includes a legend in the top-right corner identifying the two models.
